title.zh: OpenCode遭入侵，OpenAI出手补账：攻击消耗的API额度退还用户
title.en: OpenCode遭入侵，OpenAI出手补账：攻击消耗的API额度退还用户

current_state.zh: OpenCode's legacy system was breached, potentially exposing third-party model API keys for 1.4% of Console users; OpenAI is helping restore service, refunding API credits consumed during the attack, and granting Daybreak Blue defense access.
